q1.answer: The per-firm loop of lambda_handler runs from the for statement at infra/aws/lambda/investor-reporting/directory/refresh.py:1218 to its last body statement out.append(row) at refresh.py:1335; the return is at refresh.py:1336. Line 1335 is the line after which every firm's manifest write has committed and its result is collected: the manifest put at refresh.py:1308 and the dispatch-day rewrite at refresh.py:1332 run inside the loop. The directory artifact itself is written on the runner host by land() (data/assets/scripts/gold/investor_reporting/directory_runner.py:1074), not inside this function. No try/except wraps the for statement: the three try blocks (refresh.py:1232, 1307, 1321) each cover only their own statements, and their except arms (refresh.py:1276, 1310, 1333) record a classified error and continue. A failure of a stage appended after line 1335 and before the return at 1336 would be caught only by a try/except that the new stage carries itself; wrapped that way and writing only to a new key, it cannot alter out or the returned dict.

q2.answer: The served account ids per firm travel in each directory entry's ids.account_ids list, minted at data/assets/scripts/gold/investor_reporting/directory_runner.py:484-515. refresh_firm (refresh.py:944) takes them as built entries (refresh.py:1067); the previous build's entries come back as previous_entries (refresh.py:1274-1275). The compare key used by compute_delta (refresh.py:1069) and resolve_disappeared (refresh.py:1079) is a CLIENT id: ids.client_id, else ids.relationship_id (refresh.py:387-389). So the structure that carries the served account ids is entries[].ids.account_ids, which are ACCOUNT ids; the refresh's own key space is client. source_client_ids is the list of client keys the source snapshot held (directory_runner.py:965 and :1184; read back at refresh.py:872-873). A firm's directory object is the dated JSON artifact investor-reporting/directory/{as_of}/directory.json, whose entries key holds the entries and whose source_client_ids key holds the source list; the runner's pointer is investor-reporting/directory/latest.json (directory_runner.py:1049-1050), which refresh.py:738 reads. The prefix is refresh.py:70 DIRECTORY_PREFIX, taken from the environment variable IRPT_DIRECTORY_PREFIX, which schedule.tf:154 sets from local.directory_prefix (iam.tf:38 defines it as investor-reporting/directory).

q3.answer: The hook .tools/git-hooks/client-data-check.py takes each staged token matching TOKEN_RE (line 28: 5 to 24 characters of letters, digits and hyphen, with at least five digits, checked at line 66), upper-cases it (tok.upper(), line 68) and sha256-hashes it against a hash list held outside the repo. That list is one lowercase sha256 per line of the upper-cased served account id (lines 11-12). The directory's account id is not that string: directory_runner.py:160 and :484 mint it through the _ids module (opaque_id), which is sparse-excluded from this worktree and was read at HEAD with git show (surprise IRPT_BCKEND-D2-W447-S1); at HEAD it is the account kind prefix plus 24 lowercase hex digits, so UPPER of the directory id is not the hook token for the same account (surprise IRPT_BCKEND-D2-W447-S2). The declared raw key is accounts_v2.account_id (directory_runner.py:713-719), which a staged file would carry, zero-padded to ten digits. The hook's token regex excludes the underscore, so it sees at most the hex body. The served id and the hook token are different strings, not a case or padding variant of one another, so upper_equal is false.

q5.answer: The statements of data.aws_iam_policy_document.irpt_directory_refresh (infra/aws/terraform/investor-reporting/directory/schedule.tf:220) are ReadFirmDirectoryPrefixOnly, WriteRefreshManifestsOnly, ListExactlyWhatItMayAlreadyRead, OwnLogStreamOnly, DispatchTheDirectoryBuildToOneRunnerOnly, StartThatRunnerNeverStopIt and ReadBackTheCommandsThisFunctionSent. The two statements to add are secretsmanager:GetSecretValue on one secret ARN and s3:PutObject on one key. WriteRefreshManifestsOnly already grants s3:PutObject on the _refresh/ prefix (refresh_manifest_arns, schedule.tf:211-213), so a key under investor-reporting/directory/_refresh/ needs no new PutObject statement, while a key outside that prefix does. The refresh function's Lambda environment map is in schedule.tf (module irpt_directory_refresh, environment_variables at lines 152-166); lambda.tf holds the directory-search function's map instead. The refresh map carries no secret ARN or key name, so a new environment variable is needed unless the name is derived in code.
